light.method: 内置 image_gen AI 绘画
light.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. A premium collectible-toy fantasy artwork of LABUBU from THE MONSTERS, use reference strictly for character identity: long upright pointed rabbit-like ears, broad pale vinyl face, large expressive eyes, mischievous broad grin with exactly nine distinct triangular white teeth, mint-green curly plush fur and tiny tan hands/feet. No keychain, no loop, no label. LABUBU is alive in a fantastical Nordic miniature forest, leaning playfully around a large softly curled fern, standing on a mossy tree root with whimsical mushrooms and a shallow crystal-clear stream. Keep anatomical proportions and characteristic silhouette; full body and both ears entirely in frame. Sophisticated whimsical 3D mixed tactile plush/vinyl art direction, delicate curly fibers, beautiful subsurface light, controlled depth-of-field and convincing contact shadows. Daytime palette mint green, butter cream, pale moss and soft warm yellow sun shafts. Wide 16:9 target 3840x2160. LABUBU body and face at right 72%, occupying x=58%-88% and y=17%-85%. Rich scene right half, left 43% quiet misty pale mint woodland with restrained detail for later UI. Art only, no text/logo/UI/diagram/monitor panels, no copyrighted product box or packaging, no watermark. New scene composition rather than recreation of product photo.

dark.prompt: Use case lighting-weather. Transform this exact LABUBU forest scene to enchanted NIGHT. Preserve recognizable LABUBU identity, pale vinyl face, nine triangular teeth smile, huge eyes, mint curly plush fur, pose, full upright ears, body scale and fern/hands position. Keep artwork rich tactile3D and the same camera composition. Sophisticated deep ink-purple and muted berry forest, softly bioluminescent teal moss, a few warm fireflies, subdued moonlight through treetops, pale lilac rims on curly fibers. Face clearly lit with soft warm reflected light, fur still visibly mint but darker in night. Stream reflects little teal and berry lights; mushrooms tasteful soft glow, not an oversaturated rainbow. Right half detailed creature and curled fern, left43% calm atmospheric dark plum mist reserved for later real interface. Full figure remains entirely visible. Not a dark filter: redesign night illumination and material reflections. Wide16:9 target3840x2160. Art only no typography/UI/logos/labels/packaging/keychain/watermark.
